title: Agent review queue
body: Agent proposals now land in a single review queue instead of scattering across issues, so accepting a morning of triage takes one pass.
items: New Queue view lists every pending agent proposal with a diff-style preview
Bulk accept and dismiss with shift-click or the J and K keys
Duplicate suggestions now show why two issues matched
Fixed a race where two editors accepting the same proposal created a copy

title: Draft Agents
body: Agents join the workspace: duplicate detection, suggested owners, and release-note drafts — always as proposals, never silent edits.
items: Duplicate detection runs on every new issue and links likely matches
Suggested owner and severity appear in the issue peek panel
Release notes assemble automatically from a release's merged work
Per-team controls decide which agents run and who reviews them

title: Changelog domains and digests
body: Your changelog can now live on your own domain and land in your customers' inboxes without leaving Draft.
items: Custom domains with automatic certificates on Pro and above
Weekly email digest with per-subscriber frequency controls
RSS and JSON feeds for every public changelog
New compact layout for entries with many small fixes

title: Faster boards, calmer notifications
body: A quality pass across the app: board rendering rewritten for large teams, and notifications that batch instead of buzz.
items: Boards with 1,000+ issues now scroll at a steady 120 frames per second
Notifications group by issue and quiet themselves during focus hours
Cycle burndown charts gained a scope-change overlay
Fixed keyboard focus escaping the peek panel on Escape

title: Draft 2.0
body: The new foundation: a local-first sync engine, a rebuilt renderer, and offline that actually works. Everything this year builds on this release.
items: Local-first store — every read and write hits your machine first
Median cross-region sync latency cut to 50 milliseconds
Full offline mode with conflict-free merges when you reconnect
One-command import from the trackers you already use
